messages:
marta (Finance Ops): FYI — AWS MP invoice MP-2026-0456 (Apr) looks off. Two reseller customers (CloudEdge-UK and CloudEdge-DE) are missing seat usage lines, netting ~4.2k in unbilled usage. Can someone confirm before we send a query to the partner?
liam (Revenue Ops): ack. Do we have the marketplace CSV they sent? I can try to match by customer GUID.
marta (Finance Ops): Uploaded the raw CSV to /finance/marketplace/inbound/MP-2026-0456.csv. snippet below (customer GUIDs redacted):
```
customer_name,marketplace_account,seat_count,usage_units
CloudEdge-UK,acct-xxxx,0,0
CloudEdge-DE,acct-yyyy,0,0
AcmeCorp,acct-zzzz,120,36000
```
liam (Revenue Ops): looks like seat_count=0 for those two, but our internal metering shows active seats. Could be a mapping issue — partner may have sent aggregated rows under a different account id.
ajay (Partner Success): tagging our partner rep. @cloudedge-partner: can you check whether CloudEdge bundled seat reporting or used channel-reseller consolidation? They sometimes send a parent account with rollups.
sasha (SaaS Ops): billing-bot, did the MP ingest pipeline flag any schema anomalies for MP-2026-0456?
billing-bot: MP-2026-0456 processed at 2026-04-03T09:12Z. Warnings: 2 rows with seat_count==0 for accounts that match known reseller mappings. No checksum mismatch. Ingestion status: ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS.
marta (Finance Ops): OK — thanks. If partner confirms they aggregated, we still need to book a manual interim credit to avoid revenue miss. Estimate is $4,200 net for those two regions.
liam (Revenue Ops): manual credit required? That amount exceeds the $2.5k auto-approval threshold. Need one manager ok + GL memo.
ajay (Partner Success): I'll ping the partner now. If they confirm it's an aggregation error, we'll request an amended usage report and credit note.
sasha (SaaS Ops): Quick ask — are these customers on committed seats (discounted) or pay-as-you-go? That affects our refund calc.
marta (Finance Ops): CloudEdge-UK = committed 12mo, CloudEdge-DE = PAYG. I ran a quick calc: credit splits to $2,800 for committed (prorated) and $1,400 for PAYG = $4,200 total.
liam (Revenue Ops): OK. @emily (Finance Manager) can you approve a one-time manual credit of $4,200 while we await partner amended invoice? We'll tag it as 'marketplace mismap interim credit'.
emily (Finance Manager): approve. Please include GL 5012 and put note: "awaiting partner amendment MP-2026-0456".
marta (Finance Ops): Thanks — will process journal and raise AR credit memo. ajay — please push partner for amended report and a credit note. Marking this thread resolved once doc attached.
ajay (Partner Success): On it. I'll update when rep responds. :thumbsup:
marta (Finance Ops): filing final here when done: /finance/marketplace/credits/MP-2026-0456-credit-v1.pdf
